Of 1918 of said City and County of San Francisco, does hereby determine and declare that the assessment to be imposed for the said contemplated improvements, respectively, may be paid in ten installments…
Whereas, the Board of Public Works did.

Clarence B. Eaton be and is hereby granted an extension of ninety days' time from and after May 17, 1929, within which to complete the improvement of Caine avenue between Lakeview and Summit avenues under a public contract.
On recommendation of Streets and Commercial Development Committee.
